_meta.notice: Document type names and descriptions written by Pitch Black Cyber. Not copied from any assessment guide or template. The control mapping is our interpretation; an assessor may expect other documents.
_meta.method: Each entry lists the controls whose requirements imply a written document.
_meta.reviewNote: Not yet verified: each mapping must be checked by a person before release.

CMMC_L1.name: Access control policy
CMMC_L1.description: The written rules for who may use company systems and how that access is given, changed and removed.

CMMC_L1.name: Identification and authentication policy
CMMC_L1.description: The written rules for identifying users and devices and for proving who they are before access.

CMMC_L1.name: Media sanitization procedure
CMMC_L1.description: The steps for wiping or destroying media that held company information before it is reused or discarded.

CMMC_L1.name: Physical protection policy
CMMC_L1.description: The written rules for limiting physical access to facilities, equipment and operating environments.

CMMC_L1.name: Visitor log
CMMC_L1.description: A record of visitors to the facility and who escorted them.

CMMC_L1.name: Network and boundary diagram
CMMC_L1.description: A diagram of the networks and boundary of the systems that handle federal contract information.

CMMC_L1.name: System and information integrity policy
CMMC_L1.description: The written rules for fixing flaws, protecting against malicious code and keeping protection current.

CMMC_L1.name: System security plan
CMMC_L1.description: Describes the system and how each practice is met. Helpful at Level 1 but not an assessed document.

CMMC_L2.name: System security plan
CMMC_L2.description: Describes the system boundary, its environment and how each security requirement is implemented.

CMMC_L2.name: Plan of action and milestones
CMMC_L2.description: Tracks each known deficiency with an owner, a target date and the steps to correct it.

CMMC_L2.name: Incident response plan
CMMC_L2.description: Sets out how security incidents are prepared for, detected, analyzed, contained, recovered from and reported.

CMMC_L2.name: Incident response test record
CMMC_L2.description: Records when the incident response capability was exercised, what was found and what was changed.

CMMC_L2.name: Configuration management plan
CMMC_L2.description: Describes how baselines are set, changes are reviewed and approved, and settings are kept secure.

CMMC_L2.name: Baseline configurations
CMMC_L2.description: The documented approved settings for systems in scope, such as hardening standards or benchmark selections.

CMMC_L2.name: Hardware and software inventory
CMMC_L2.description: The current list of hardware and software that make up the system in scope.

CMMC_L2.name: Risk assessment
CMMC_L2.description: A dated assessment of the risks to operations and information from the system, with its findings.

CMMC_L2.name: Security assessment results
CMMC_L2.description: The results of the periodic review of how well the security requirements are met.

CMMC_L2.name: Network and boundary diagram
CMMC_L2.description: A diagram of the networks, connections and boundary of the system in scope.

CMMC_L2.name: Access control policy
CMMC_L2.description: The organization's written policy for access control: purpose, scope, roles and the rules staff follow.

CMMC_L2.description: The organization's written policy for personnel security: purpose, scope, roles and the rules staff follow.

CMMC_L2.description: The organization's written policy for physical protection: purpose, scope, roles and the rules staff follow.

CMMC_L2.description: The organization's written policy for system and communications protection: purpose, scope, roles and the rules staff follow.

CMMC_L2.name: Acceptable use policy
CMMC_L2.description: States what staff may and may not do with company systems and information; often signed by each user.

CMMC_L2.name: Shared responsibility matrix
CMMC_L2.description: Shows which security requirements are met by the organization and which by an external service provider.

NIST_800_53_REV5.name: System security plan
NIST_800_53_REV5.description: Describes the system, its boundary and how each selected control is implemented.

NIST_800_53_REV5.name: Plan of action and milestones
NIST_800_53_REV5.description: Tracks each known weakness with an owner, a target date and the steps to correct it.

NIST_800_53_REV5.name: Incident response plan
NIST_800_53_REV5.description: Sets out how incidents are prepared for, handled and reported, and who does what.

NIST_800_53_REV5.name: Contingency plan
NIST_800_53_REV5.description: Describes how essential functions continue or are restored after a disruption, and who is responsible.

NIST_800_53_REV5.name: Configuration management plan
NIST_800_53_REV5.description: Describes how configuration items are identified, changes are controlled and the plan is kept current.

NIST_800_53_REV5.name: Continuous monitoring strategy
NIST_800_53_REV5.description: Describes what is monitored, how often, how results are reported and who acts on them.

NIST_800_53_REV5.name: Security assessment plan and report
NIST_800_53_REV5.description: The plan for assessing the controls and the written report of what the assessment found.

NIST_800_53_REV5.name: Risk assessment
NIST_800_53_REV5.description: A dated assessment of the risks to operations and information from the system, with its results.

NIST_800_53_REV5.name: Supply chain risk management plan
NIST_800_53_REV5.description: Describes how risks from suppliers, products and services are identified and managed.

NIST_800_53_REV5.name: Rules of behavior
NIST_800_53_REV5.description: States what users may and may not do on the system; usually acknowledged by each user.

NIST_800_53_REV5.name: Interconnection agreements
NIST_800_53_REV5.description: Agreements covering connections to other systems, where such connections exist.

NIST_800_53_REV5.name: Baseline configuration
NIST_800_53_REV5.description: The documented approved settings and components for the system, kept under change control.

NIST_800_53_REV5.name: System component inventory
NIST_800_53_REV5.description: The current list of hardware, software and firmware components that make up the system.
